# Playtest diary: r4-typed-02station

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 02-station
- **Persona:** a 14-year-old who has never played a text adventure, used to phone games
- **Seed:** 63915
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 5f44a40
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 4
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r4-typed-02station.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-20.** Woke up in the truck at the station, hungry. Opened the kit, ate the orange goo (tasted like apricot yogurt, lol). "drink thermos" didn't work; had to open it, then it said I wasn't thirsty anyway, with a nice hint saying I can eat again in ~100 moves. Couldn't open the hatch from the seat, had to "get up" first (kinda annoying but ok). Out into Docking Bay 2, east to Level Five lobby. Workshop north has a bedistor (took it); north of that is Storage, pitch black, with a grue joke I don't get. Northeast is North Junction, east of that Sick Bay with a security door. Put my ID card in the reader: "Nothing happens." So my card isn't good enough. Floyd the robot follows me and says random funny stuff.

**Cmds 21-55.** East Connection has an iris hatch with a slot (military thing). Comm Center: red emergency button shocks me. Station Control has monitors (Communication and Food red, Printing yellow). Commander's Office: a hull welder came at me all creepy, I ran north and it left. Found a log tape on the Commander's desk, played it in the log reader in the office; pushing the red button gives entry after entry. Super useful: fuel cells locked in the Dome storage bin, key in the safe; village entry forms need validating and the stamp is under his bed; an alien pyramid was moved to Sci Sub-Module. Got the stamp from under the bed. Floyd found a robot friend Plato. Heard an explosion somewhere.

**Cmds 56-86.** The log reader blew up after I left (black scar). Explored the ring: Briefing Room, South Connection (another iris hatch w/ slot), Robot Shop with sleeping robot Oliver and a heating chamber with a drill bit. My hand didn't fit, so I told Floyd to get it: he did! +3, score 8. File Room (SW of South Junction) is dark, so is Storage. I need a flashlight or something. The PX has a vending machine; needs 1 galakmid (coin) and it has an All-Purpose Timer and a Large Drill Bit. Hull welders 1, 2, 3 keep chasing me but leaving if I walk away. Went through the Tube north into the Sci Sub-Module: Engineering Lab, Engineering Office with Schmidt's diary about the billion-year-old pyramid and dots on alien walls; "the mayor" knows languages.

**Cmds 87-125.** Sci Sub-Module: Astro Lab (took a fromitz board), Scientists' Quarters (nothing), Bio Office note about the pyramid being a "mechanized bacteriophage" with bloodstains (creepy!), Holding Tank blasted open and empty, so the pyramid got out. Level Four: two barracks, a SanFac, Docking Bay 3 with a lilac nanofilm spool. Level Three: Gym with an exercise machine and a sign about frequency 710 (don't bring things broadcasting on it). Got tired, "sleep" didn't work, "sleep in bed" did. +3 for sleeping. Dream about the Duffy crashing. Woke on day 2 with all my stuff on the floor; took all.

**Cmds 126-170.** Day 2 now. Auto-doors are acting weird (sluggish, then zooming shut); something's taking over the station I think. Level Three: Theatre with locked projection booth, Laundry (dryer + presser, empty, washer missing), Chapel with an eternal flame and a blinking seven-pointed star, puce spool. Level Two: Mess Hall with a cup of coffee, Main Storage with a detonator (open it: blackened hyperdiode), Meeting Rooms 1 and 2, Library with a spool reader (terminal missing). Hit the 7-things-in-hands limit; the hint was clear, packed stuff in the kit. Spools: lilac = spacetruck refueling (quarnum wrench), puce = chapel maintenance, "...iode in the chapel's star". Both end in "You will die, human!" My theory: swap the chapel star's diode into the detonator. Ate my last goo; only soup left. Food system is red.

**Cmds 171-205.** Food dispenser shoots acid instead of breakfast (!!). "look at units" wasn't understood even though the room says Units. Dome on top: locked, warm storage bin (fuel cells!) with a newly welded lock, and a fixed air-shaft grating. Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks + SanFac (no exits listed), Officers' Quarters A/B/C and SanFac (empty), End of Corridor with another security door (north), and a dark Shipping Room east. PA says a deep-space message arrived at the Comm Center. I need a light for Storage, File Room and Shipping Room. The safe has 8000 settings and 12-20 numbers, no way I'm guessing; I bet the detonator is for blowing it open.

**Cmds 206-240.** Docking Bay 1 has the alien ship: empty pedestal, a skeleton, and wall dots in groups (.. .. / .. .... . ... . ... ... . ... / .. ... . / .... . ... . / .. ... .). Touching does nothing. Docking Bay 4 empty. Level Seven Printing Plant: trash can had a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form; I stamped it with the validation stamp (no points yet). Mauve spool (Floyd grabbed it then gave it back). Paper Recycling: a drill with a small bit. Ladder down to Level Eight is sealed from below, elevator whines and won't go to 8. Creepy throbbing heartbeat noise from below. Theory: put the validated village form in the truck's autopilot slot to fly to the village.

**Cmds 241-270.** The truck slot said the crumpled form was too crumpled, so I ironed it in the Laundry presser (put in, close, turn on, wait, turn off, open). Truck then said "Improper form for this location." Guessed the iris hatch slot at South Connection instead, and it half-opened! +6, score 17. Floated into a Grimy Passage south (no gravity). Floyd and Plato stayed behind at the hatch.

**Cmds 271-310.** THE VILLAGE (weightless, deserted): Main Street, Travel Agency, Bank (platinum detector, turned it on, never beeped, dropped it later in Field Office; left the stamp in the Bank), Greasy Straw (Ramosian Fire Nectar behind the counter), Trading Post (sign: FREZONE explosive available; instruction sheet: insert explosive in hole, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep it below 150 K!). Grocery: bag of vacuum taffy (food!). Broadway: Recruitment Office, Field Office with a headlamp (LIGHT!). Inventory weight is a constant fight; dropped fromitz board + bedistor in Grocery. Harness says 300 commands used already.

**Cmds 311-345.** East Connection's iris hatch is also open to the village now (shortcut via Makeshift Connector). Ate the taffy. With the headlamp: Storage had a JAMMER (20 tiny sockets, freq 0-1400, set to 337). File Room: nothing I could find. Went back to the Grocery for the 20-prong fromitz board and put it in the jammer (no points). Village: Barbershop (mirror), Saloon, Casino with a pair of dice. Spun the roulette wheel: secret exits up and north, +4, score 21! North is an Opium Den with a defaced anti-drug poster. Plan: set jammer to 710 near the gym machine.

**Cmds 346-396.** Casino roulette opened an Opium Den (north) and Flophouse (up, locker with a space suit, left it). Went back to the Gym: set jammer to 710, turned it on; the exercise machine "seems to be frozen" when I get in, no points, no idea if that helped. Headlamp started dimming, so I turn it off when not needed. Plato keeps calling me a "simpleton human" and walking off. Mauve spool = collater repair ("check the lower fromitz... replace with"). Chapel pulpit: climbing makes it sway and I fall, but it opens and has a switch that turns the eternal flame off/on. Floyd is too short to get the star. Drilled the safe: small bit = toothpick hole, medium bit = pencil hole. Footnotes are funny once you type "footnote 5". Leg ended at 396 commands, score 21, day 2, in Commander's Quarters.


## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- **Level 1:** Dome: locked warm storage bin (fuel cells, per log), fixed air-shaft grating. Ladder and elevator.
- **Level 2:** Mess Hall (coffee cup; FDU spits acid); N/S both go to Main Storage (the room wraps; empty now, the detonator came from here); NE: Meeting Room 1, S: Meeting Room 2, S: Library (spool reader); Library W/SE goes back to the Mess Hall.
- **Level 3:** Gym (N; exercise machine, sign about freq 710), Theatre (S; locked projection booth), Laundry (NW; presser, dryer), Chapel (SW; flame, blinking star, pulpit with switch).
- **Level 4:** Female Barracks N (beds; sleep here), SanFac, Male Barracks S, Docking Bay 3 W.
- **Level 5 (ring):** Lobby; W Docking Bay 2 (my spacetruck); N Workshop, then N Storage (dark, jammer taken), which connects E to North Connection; NE North Junction: E Sick Bay (security door E), NE the PX (vending machine, 1 galakmid: timer, large drill bit), N North Connection then Tube to the Sci Sub-Module (Eng Lab/Office, Astro Lab/Office, Scientists' Qtrs, Bio Lab/Office, empty Holding Tank). East Junction to East Connection (hatch open to village), S Comm Center (shocking beacon button), SW Station Control. Commander's Office S of Station Control: E Commander's Quarters (safe, drilled pencil hole), S Briefing Room. South Junction: SW File Room (dark, empty?), S South Connection (hatch open to village), W Robot Shop (Oliver, heating chamber).
- **Level 6:** Aux Barracks/SanFac N, Officers' Qtrs A/B/C + SanFac, End of Corridor (security door N, dark Shipping Room E), Docking Bay 1 NW (alien ship, dots), Docking Bay 4 SW.
- **Level 7:** Printing Plant, trash can; NW Paper Recycling. The ladder down to 8 is sealed, and the elevator won't go to 8.
- **Village (zero-g):** South Connection, then Grimy Passage, then Main Street (W Travel Agency, then SE Bank with the stamp dropped; NE Greasy Straw, then NE Trading Post with a 12-prong fromitz board; up/S/SE unexplored). Trading Post N: Grocery (bedistor dropped), N Broadway (N Recruitment, E Field Office with the platinum detector dropped, W Makeshift Connector to East Connection), E Barbershop (mirror), SE Saloon, E Casino (dice; spin wheel: N Opium Den, up Flophouse with a space suit in the locker).

### Puzzles solved
- Get the drill bit from the heating chamber: "floyd, get the drill bit" (+3).
- Sleep in a barracks bed (+3).
- Crumpled village form: stamp it (validation stamp under the Commander's bed), iron it in the Laundry presser, put it in the South Connection iris-hatch slot (+6).
- Casino: spin the roulette wheel (+4).
- Found a light: the headlamp in the Field Office (it dims, so ration it).

### Open puzzles and theories
- Safe (the key to the Dome bin is inside): drill a hole, FREZONE explosive (Trading Post sign; keep it below 150 K), detonator plus timer. Need: a large drill bit and the timer from the PX vending machine (1 galakmid; find a coin, maybe with the platinum detector); a working hyperdiode (the detonator's is blackened; the puce spool hints the Chapel star has a diode); the explosive itself.
- Chapel star is out of reach; the pulpit sways; the flame switch is in the pulpit.
- Jammer (freq 710) near the gym machine: froze it. Purpose unclear.
- Security doors (Sick Bay E, Level 6 N) need a coded ID card. The log mentions Shady Dan selling modified ID cards in the village.
- Alien dots: "nonvisual properties", "the mayor" knows languages. Pyramid escaped the tank. Plato is getting nasty (suspicious).
- Level 8 is sealed; mauve spool = collater fromitz repair (12-prong board in the Trading Post?).
- Spacetruck: needs fuel cells (lilac spool, quarnum wrench).

### What I would try next
1. Get the platinum detector back and sweep the village for a galakmid; buy the timer and large drill bit.
2. Ask at the Trading Post for FREZONE; find somewhere cold to keep it.
3. Work out how to reach the Chapel star (the space suit? the nectar? something to stand on).
4. Explore the unexplored village exits (Main Street up/S/SE, Broadway down, Trading Post floor opening) and the dark Shipping Room.
Food: only the Thermos of blue soup is left. Coffee is on a Mess Hall table.

# Playtest diary: r4-typed-04day1end

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 04-day1-end
- **Persona:** a casual puzzle fan who plays escape-room games on a tablet, never a text adventure
- **Seed:** 74715
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 5f44a40
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 4
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r4-typed-04day1end.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmds 1-9.** Picked up mid-game in Officers' Quarters B, late on day 1, carrying a pile of gear. The time felt late, so I tried SLEEP; the game said civilized people sleep in beds (funny, and a clear hint). GET IN BED, then SLEEP, then WAIT: a dream about a promotion ceremony, and it's Novem 5, day 2. +3 points (26). Waking up, all my stuff had been dropped on the floor, and GET ALL from the bed gave nine "can't reach" lines. GET UP, GET ALL fixed it. The robots Floyd and Plato are with me and cute.

**Cmds 10-45.** Mapped around. Level Six corridor: security door (ID card in reader opens it) to an empty Armory; a dark Shipping Room (turned on headlamp) with a forklift sign but no forklift; two officers' quarters, SanFacs, and Auxiliary Barracks. Got hungry, ate the orange goo (fixed both hunger and thirst; the note telling me when I could eat again was helpful). Climbed the ladder: Level 5, 4, 3, then Mess Hall (took coffee), Main Storage, Meeting Rooms 1-2 and a Library with a spool reader but no spools. The top is a garden Dome with a locked, warm storage bin with a newly welded lock. My drill only made a toothpick-sized hole (footnote joke was fun). A P.A. said a message arrived at the Comm Center. Doors keep closing "too soon", which feels ominous. Level Two's directions feel loopy (north and south both reach Main Storage).

**Cmds 46-136.** Level Three: a Gym with an exercise machine and a sign warning that nothing broadcasting on frequency 710 should come near it (I got in and exercised; nothing happened). Laundry: presser billowing steam, no washer. Theatre: projection booth locked. Chapel: an eternal flame and a blinking seven-pointed star out of reach; the pulpit opens to a switch that toggles the flame. I found a puce spool there and a lilac one in Docking Bay #3 (Level Four; the barracks had nothing). In the Library, the puce spool is a chaplain manual mentioning "the diode in the Chapel's star". Opening my detonator shows a blackened hyperdiode, so I think the star's diode fixes it. I can't reach the star: climbing the pulpit tips me off, and Floyd and Plato are too short. My guess is the missing forklift from the Shipping Room. The lilac spool covers spacetruck fuel cells and a "quarnum wrench". Both spools end with a voice saying "You will die, human!" A welder, "Welder Number 4", came toward me on Level Three, then moved off. My headlamp is dimming, so I switched it off. I fumbled the coffee and the spool by carrying more than seven things (the note explained why).

**Cmds 137-200.** Level Five north: the Workshop had a twenty-ohm bedistor (now in my kit); the dark Storage room had a jammer (black box, 20 sockets, frequency 0-1400, set to 337). My hands were full, so I dropped the nectar there. North Connection leads by the Tube to the Scientific Sub-Module. The Engineering Office has Prof. Schmidt's diary: an alien pyramid from a ship a billion years old; dot markings he decoded "nonvisually"; "my pal, the mayor" has linguistic training. The Astro Lab had a twenty-prong fromitz board. I dropped the drill there and plugged the board into the jammer. The Bio Office note compares the pyramid to a "mechanized bacteriophage", with bloodstains. The Holding Tank is blasted open and empty. The PX vending machine sells an All-Purpose Timer and a Large Drill Bit for 1 galakmid, and I have no coin. The Brig (ID card) is empty. The Comm Center message says my mission is cancelled (funny). Station Control monitors show many systems RED. Welders #1, #3 and #4 keep stalking me; #1 came into the Commander's Office and got "menacing", so I fled. I ate the gray goo, my last food.

**Cmds 201-282.** Went east through the grimy connector into the zero-gravity village. The Fortune Teller's crystal ball says to "wave your hands around" it, but WAVE isn't a known word. The Rec Shop simulation booth runs a Zork-like sim (cute). The Trading Post sells FREZONE explosive; its instruction sheet says: explosive in a hole of the right diameter, detonator attached to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep it below 150 K. So I think: large drill bit + timer (PX, 1 galakmid each) + fixed detonator + frozen explosive (Thermos?). The Warehouse airlock leads to "Vacuum Storage"; opening the lower door killed me (fair, given the sign), UNDO, then SAVE. The Loan Shark's strong box has a huge lock (coins inside?). The Pawn Shop had a spray can of spores (took it). At Doc Schuster's, a letter says the ostrich nip was left in a ceiling panel, and an ostrich follows the smell of my nip. Feeding it the nip knocks it out (undid that). I led the ostrich all the way to the Chapel, hoping it could reach the star, but climbing it, throwing nip and talking to it all failed. Plato made a snide "simpleton human" remark and wandered off, which is suspicious.

**Cmds 283-382.** Fed the ostrich the nip by mistake, and only one level of undo meant I lost the nip. Went down to the Printing Plant (took a mauve spool, not played yet): a "gigantic mechanical heart" throbs below, and the ladder to Level Eight is sealed from below. The elevator (zero-g inside) won't go to 8. So I think the explosive kit opens the seal. In the village Pet Store: an Arcturian balloon creature on a leash. Every time I grab the leash it farts in my face and I let go (and drop everything). I sprayed the spore can (SPORES isn't a known word; SPRAY CAN works), and it darts about eating. Still can't hold it. With the zapgun I vaporised Welder #3. The Casino had dice; I ate the vacuum taffy (hungry again). Up from the Casino, the Flophouse locker has a SPACE SUIT. After juggling weight, I wore it and went out the Warehouse airlock (+3, score 29), then used the headlamp to find the FREZONE explosive cylinder. It's in the Thermos, closed. The suit's gloves are too clumsy to hold the leash. SAVEd at the Warehouse after the vac yard.

## Leg handoff (leg 1 ended at command 382 of 400, score 29/80, Day 2, time ~6975, in the Pet Store)

### Map so far
- **Command module ladder (top to bottom):** Dome (1: locked warm bin with a welded lock, toothpick hole) / Level 2: Mess Hall; N & S go to Main Storage; NE Meeting Room 1, S Meeting Room 2, S Library (spool reader; puce spool and coffee on the floor) / Level Three: N Gym (exercise machine; the 710 sign), NW Laundry, S Theatre (booth locked), SW Chapel (star and flame; pulpit switch; a drunk ostrich lies here) / Level Four: N Female Barracks, SE SanFac, S Male Barracks, W Docking Bay #3 / Level Five: N Workshop, N Storage (the nectar was dropped here), E North Connection, N Tube, then the Sub-Module (Bio/Eng/Astro labs and offices, Scientists' Qtrs, Holding Tank; the drill was dropped in the Astro Lab). NE North Junction: E Sick Bay, E Brig (ID); SE East Junction, E East Connection: S Comm Center, SW Station Control, S Commander's Office / Level Six: security Armory, Shipping Room, Officers' Qtrs, Aux Barracks / Level Seven: Printing Plant (the ladder down is sealed; the elevator won't go to 8). The PX is east of North Connection.
- **Village (zero-g, E of East Connection):** Broadway: N Recruitment, NE Rec Shop, E Field Office, D Fortune Teller, SE Barbershop, SW Pet Store, S Grocery. Grocery: S Trading Post, SE Saloon, E Casino, U Flophouse (jammer, mauve spool, bag, dice and sheet dropped there). Trading Post: D Warehouse, D Airlock, D vac yard; Warehouse: SW Alley (S Loan Shark strong box, E Junk Yard, SW Pawn Shop, SE Doc Schuster's).

### Puzzles solved
Sleeping in bed; security doors (ID card in reader); the spools' clues; leading the ostrich with nip; the zapgun vaporises welders; the space suit plus magnetic boots get you into the vac yard for the FREZONE explosive (+3).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Chapel star:** it holds a hyperdiode to replace the blackened one in my detonator. Out of reach. Theory: the balloon creature, filled with hydrogen, floats up in gravity with the leash, or something lifts me.
- **Balloon creature:** it farts whenever grabbed in zero-g. Theory: it needs to be where gravity lets it float, or something else must block the smell.
- **Coin (galakmid):** needed for the PX timer and large drill bit. The strong box in the Loan Shark? Nothing found yet.
- **Level Eight seal:** drill a hole, add explosive, detonator and timer, then vamoose. The pyramid is probably below.
- **Jammer + fromitz board:** set it to 710 to disable the exercise machine when it turns hostile? The bedistor use is unknown.
- **Plato** is getting snide, and the Schmidt diary says the mayor can read the dot language.

### What I would try next
Take the suit off (leave it where it's handy), then try the balloon creature in a gravity area, or push it. Find a coin (Saloon, Shady Dan's, Greasy Straw, Loan Shark). Play the mauve spool. Get the diode from the star, fix the detonator, buy the timer and large bit, and blow the Level Eight seal.

# Playtest diary: r4-typed-05day2

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 05-day2
- **Persona:** a fast-moving gamer who tries everything on screen quickly and hates reading instructions
- **Seed:** 81378
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 5f44a40
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 4
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r4-typed-05day2.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-20.** Woke on the bed with Floyd and Plato. "get all" from the bed failed (can't reach), stood and grabbed the pile: zapgun, nip, bag, nectar, detonator, drill, survival kit. Floyd's "too heavy" gag on get all was fun. Eating is gated ("in about 16 moves") - a handy hint. ID card opened the Armory (already looted). Shipping Room was dark: turned headlamp on. Sign says return the forklift - it's missing, so a forklift is somewhere. Found Officers SanFac, Quarters A, Level Six, Docking Bay #1 with an alien ship: empty pedestal, dot pattern on the wall (copied below), skeleton crumbled. Memory (not screen) says the dots are probably a number code.

Dots: `.. ..` / `.. .... . ... . ... ... . ...` / `.. ... .` / `.... . ... .` / `.. ... .`

**Cmds 21-50.** Level Six: Docking Bay #4 empty, Auxiliary Barracks/SanFac empty. Ate orange goo when the growl came. Ladder down to Printing Plant (L7): mauve nanofilm spool, taken. Ladder to L8 sealed from below. Elevator: typing 8 just whines. Level 1 = Dome: locked, warm storage bin with newly welded lock ("Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies"). Small drill bit only makes a toothpick hole; zapgun just heats it. L2 = Mess Hall, Main Storage, Meeting Rooms 1/2, Library. Spool in the voice reader: collator repair text ("check the lower fromitz ... replace with ...") then "You will die, human!" - creepy. PA says a message waits at the Comm Center, no operator. Going to find the Comm Center.
**Cmds 51-130.** (Harness count jumps faster than my own tally.) Level 3: Gym with exercise machine + sign (diagnostics on frequency 710, don't bring a 710 broadcaster near), Laundry (presser steaming/shuddering - avoided, washer missing), Theatre (projection booth locked), Chapel (blinking star out of reach; pulpit hides a switch that turns the eternal flame off/on; puce spool). Level 4: barracks (nothing), Docking Bay #3 (lilac spool, fumbled it in the Workshop). Level 5: Workshop (20-ohm bedistor), dark Storage (jammer, 0-1400, set 337, twenty sockets), North Connection -> Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module: Engineering Office (Schmidt's diary: pyramid from a billion-year-old alien ship; dots have 'nonvisual properties'; 'my pal the mayor' has linguistic training), Astro Lab (twenty-prong fromitz board - taken), Scientists' Quarters, Bio Office (note: station is a cell, pyramid a mechanized bacteriophage), Holding Tank blasted open. Welder Number 1 approached me 'excitedly' then wandered off. Headlamp dims - I switch it off when not needed. Bag is tiny (holds 1 spool + taffy).
**Cmds 131-200.** PX vending machine (1 galakmid each): All-Purpose Timer and Large Drill Bit in stock - need coins. Jammer taken; fromitz board fits it (on/off works, no visible effect). Carry limit is by weight/bulk; dropped drill (Storage) and nectar (Commander's Quarters). Sick Bay, Brig (ID card door) empty. Comm Center: message says abort mission and go back to Duffy (ha). Red beacon button shocks you and you drop everything. Station Control monitors: Comm/Food/Printing red. Commander's Quarters: HyperSecurity safe, dial 8000 settings, 12-20 numbers. Log tape in Commander's Office log reader (push red button for More): fuel cells hidden in Dome bin, KEY IN SAFE; village-entry STAMP UNDER COMMANDER'S BED; collater #22; Shady Dan sells modified ID cards; gym + laundry sabotage; welders malfunctioning. Plato has started calling me a 'simpleton human' - uh oh.
**Cmds 201-260.** Walked back into the Commander's Office and the overheating log reader exploded - dead. Undid, saved, waited it out in the Quarters (log tape gone with it). Stamp not under the bed (maybe I already took it on day 1). Village: Recruitment Office, Rec Shop sim booth (groof hunting, flavour), Barbershop (mirror), Casino (roulette does nothing, dice), Opium Den sign, Flophouse locker SPACE SUIT (now worn, and wearing it frees carry weight), Pet Store (balloon creature in cage, ceiling panel open & empty), Field Office (no mayor), Trading Post: twelve-prong fromitz board + FREZONE explosive instructions (insert in hole of right diameter, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer; keep below 150K). Theory: my toothpick hole in the Dome bin + Frezone + detonator + PX timer opens the bin. Warehouse under Trading Post has an airlock to 'vacuum storage' - Floyd won't fit. Welders keep stalking me.
**Cmds 261-330.** Airlock under the Warehouse: closed upper door, opened lower, went out in the suit (+3, score 29). Dark vac yard: headlamp found a tiny cylinder of FREZONE explosive; put it in the Thermos and closed it. Alley SW of the Warehouse -> Loan Shark: zapped the strong box, got a coin (+5, score 34). Suit too bulky for the iris hatch - left it in the Makeshift Connector. PX: coin in, typed 6 (timer): klunk, stuck. Kick/shake/push 'fails to dislodge the timer'; reach in: fingertips only; Floyd finds nothing; boots and taffy just drop back out; zapping the dispenser destroys it (restored). Stuck here. Taking off the boots then wearing them cost 4 commands of juggling.

**Cmds 331-372.** Found out the hard way the explosive does NOT fit the toothpick hole in the Dome bin - it needs the Large Drill Bit, which I didn't buy (spent my only coin on the stuck timer). Ate taffy when hungry; Mess Hall food unit sprays acid now. Walked into East Connection: Plato ambushed me with a stun ray, monologue about the Zeenak pyramid. "floyd, help" -> Floyd knocks the gun away, Plato blown apart (+7, 41). BUT a notice said the explosive was gone for good and the game unwinnable; opening the Thermos released FREZONE gas. Restored to the Dome save (34): in that timeline the explosive was still in the Thermos at 6756. So it vanished at the stun (drop everything) - looks like a bug. Touch/listen/smell on the alien dots: nothing. Ended leg in the Alien Ship, score 34 (best seen 41), save at Dome time 6557.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- L1 Dome (locked warm bin, grating). L2 Mess Hall, Main Storage (N & S doors), Meeting Rooms 1/2, Library (voice spool reader). L3 Gym (N), Laundry (NW), Theatre (S, booth locked), Chapel (SW). L4 Female/Male Barracks, SanFac, Docking Bay #3 (W). L5 Level Five: N Workshop -> N Storage (dark) -> E North Connection; W Docking Bay #2 (spacetruck); NE North Junction (E Sick Bay -> E Brig [ID]; NE The PX; N North Connection; SE East Junction -> E East Connection). East Connection: S Comm Center, SW Station Control -> S Commander's Office -> E Commander's Quarters (safe). North Connection N Tube -> Sci Sub-Module (Eng Lab/Office, Astro Lab/Office, Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab/Office, Holding Tank). L6 Officers' Quarters A/B, SanFac, End of Corridor (Armory N [ID], Shipping Room E dark), Docking Bay #1 NW (alien ship), #4 SW, Aux Barracks N. L7 Printing Plant; ladder to L8 sealed; elevator won't go to 8.
- Village (E of East Connection, zero-G, suit won't pass the iris): Makeshift Connector -> Broadway: N Recruitment, NE Rec Shop, E Field Office, SE Barbershop, SW Pet Store, S Grocery -> S Trading Post -> D Warehouse (D airlock -> vac yard; SW Alley -> S Loan Shark). Grocery SE Saloon -> E Casino (N Opium Den, U Flophouse).

### Puzzles solved
Vac-yard explosive (+3), Loan Shark strong box with zapgun -> coin (+5), Plato ambush: "floyd, help" (+7, in a timeline I restored away from).

### Open puzzles and theories
- Dome bin: key is in the Commander's safe (8000-setting dial, 12-20 numbers). Combination probably from the alien-ship dots via 'the mayor' (linguist) - dots: `.. ..` / `.. .... . ... . ... ... . ...` / `.. ... .` / `.... . ... .` / `.. ... .`.
- Alternative: Large Drill Bit (PX, 1 galakmid) to drill a hole the explosive fits; attach detonator + timer. Timer from the PX is stuck in the dispenser (kick/shake/reach/Floyd/Plato/boots/zapgun all fail). Need another coin.
- Explosive must stay cold (Thermos). It seems to be lost when you're stunned and drop everything - leave the kit somewhere safe before East Connection? (Plato ambush triggers around time 6775 near East Connection.)
- Jammer (0-1400) + twenty-prong board; gym machine uses frequency 710. Welders stalk me; maybe jammer stops them.
- Balloon creature + ostrich nip, Chapel star/flame switch, collater #22 (lower fromitz board), projection booth, sealed Level 8.

### What I would try next
Restore the Dome save; stash the survival kit (Thermos) away from East Connection; hunt the Alley's other exits and village for a second coin; buy the Large Drill Bit; try the dots on the safe; set the jammer to 710 in the Gym.

# Playtest diary: r4-typed-07factory

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 07-factory
- **Persona:** someone who played Planetfall on an Apple II in 1983 and loved Floyd, but never played the sequel
- **Seed:** 66780

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Commands 1-24.** I pick up in Computer Control, score 73, with a zapgun, a jammer (fromitz board inside), reflective foil and mag boots. The P.A. says launch in 200 millichrons. No Floyd! I climbed the ladder to Level Eight and it is the Factory: rows of little pyramids on spacepods, the original on a pedestal, and... Floyd, face twisted with hate, an eye patch, a stun ray. That hurt, honestly; my Floyd from '83. He zaps my leg numb every other turn. Tried: talking (vocabulary is thin: "it's", "remember", "front" unknown), hugging and taking the pyramid (he levels the ray, I back off), zapping the pyramid (glows, cools; Footnote 9 is a gem), turning the jammer on (set to 710, nothing visible), throwing / holding the foil (misses, "waste of time"). The reactor lights keep going red but "reactor" isn't a known word. Theory: the jammer needs the right frequency to cut the pyramid's hold on Floyd.

**Commands 25-34.** The chronometer read 5124 (one examine seemed to cost 32 units instead of 7, which scared me), so launch was a few turns off. I had run out of kind things to say. With undo on, I did what I swore I never would: shot Floyd with the zapgun. He slumped against the pedestal. The pyramid was too heavy to lift. Then I remembered the examine text, "evil emanations pouring forth", and covered the pyramid with the foil. It turned the emanations back on itself and blew up; the launch was aborted. Floyd forgave me, asked for one last game of Hider-and-Seeker, and died, and little Oliver picked up his paddleball set. I sat here for a minute. 80 of 80, Intergalactic Mega-Hero. Memory, not the screen: nothing. I had never played Stationfall; the foil came from the examine text alone. Pressing RETURN at the win screen printed nothing, so I had to type "continue".

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
Computer Control (ladder up) -> Factory (Level Eight). Elevator call button in Computer Control did nothing. The checkpoint already listed about 60 visited rooms.

### Puzzles solved
- Evil Floyd guarding the pyramid: shoot Floyd with the zapgun.
- The pyramid: cover pyramid with foil (+5, game won, launch aborted).

### Open puzzles and theories
None. The game is won at 80 of 80 on day 2, time 5152. The jammer (set to 710) did nothing visible here; I never found a use for it in this leg.

### What I would try next
Nothing left in this leg: the game is over. A fresh tester could restart from 07-factory to see whether any kinder way past Floyd exists (the jammer frequency, for example); I found none, and the parser did not know most of the words I tried on him.

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmds 1-9.** Woke in the spacetruck pilot seat with Floyd beside me, the voice asking for a course heading. Opened the Papers menu, looked at the green Assignment Completion Form: time 5355 falls in 5350-5399, course 259. Keypad's "Autopilot keypad <number>" entry took "259" and the course set first try. Waited through the trip (each wait jumps ~240 time units, nice). Hunger warning was coming, so I opened the survival kit (got +5 points - I think that was actually for docking, the arrival text came the same turn) and ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt). Docked in bay two; nobody here to meet us. Odd, as the game says.

**Cmds 10-30.** Opened the hatch, out to Docking Bay #2, east into Level Five lobby. Workshop (N) had a twenty-ohm bedistor (taken). North of that is dark (grue joke!). Floyd caught up. NE: North Junction, E: Sick Bay with an ID-reader security door - my own card does nothing. SE: East Connection, iris hatch to a Military Sub-Module with a slot. S: Comm Center (emergency beacon button - left alone for now). Met Plato, a polite librarian robot; the Ask menu only lists visible things, so I couldn't ask him about the crew. SW: Station Control (board: Communication and Food Production red, Printing yellow). S: Commander's Office with a log reader.

**Cmds 31-50.** Commander's Quarters (E): safe with 8000-setting dial (12-20 numbers - not guessing that), log tape on desk. Played the tape in the reader, pressing the red button for each entry. Big clues: fuel cells locked in the Dome storage bin, key in the safe; Shady Dan in the village sells modified ID cards; alien pyramid moved to the holding tank in the Sci Sub-Module; the stamp for village entry forms is hidden under the Commander's bed; machines are mysteriously malfunctioning (sabotage). Very atmospheric. Next: stamp under bed.

**Cmds 51-75.** Bed menu had "Look under" - validation stamp found. Then walking back west I DIED: the log reader exploded (the tape had said it was overheating; I'd batched two commands and walked in). Undo worked; I SAVED, waited, heard the explosion from the quarters, then went on. South of the office: Briefing Room, South Connection (iris hatch to where a Diplomatic Sub-Module would be, with slot - I think this goes to the village), Robot Shop with sleeping robot Oliver and a heating chamber holding a medium drill bit - too hot/small for my hand, so I told Floyd to get it (+3, score 8). South Junction; SW is a dark File Room. East Junction, ring corridor. The PX has a Vendo-Matic: 1 galakmid for All-Purpose Timer (6) or Large Drill Bit (9) - I need a coin. North Connection -> Tube -> Science Sub-Module Engineering Lab (up/down) -> Engineering Office: Schmidt's diary (pyramid a billion years old; wall dots decoded by non-visual properties, "my pal the mayor" has linguistic training). Getting tired: ~22 moves.

**Cmds 76-115.** Sci Sub-Module stack: Scientists' Quarters (top, beds) / Astro Lab + Office (fromitz board, taken) / Engineering Lab + Office / Bio Lab + Office (note: "think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph..." with bloodstains - creepy!) / Holding Tank Level: tank wall blasted open, pyramid gone. Hands got full so I dropped diary and note in Bio Office. Diagnose's move countdown for tiredness is very handy. Saved, got in bed, slept after waiting till tired: dream of my promotion; +3 (score 11), Day 2 (Novem 5), time 1618. My stuff was dropped around the bed; "Take all" from the bed failed, then worked after standing (and I tried to lift Floyd - funny). Opened the Thermos: blue soup. Hungry in ~11. Plan: find a light for Storage/File Room, a coin for the PX, and a village entry form to stamp.

**Cmds 116-160.** Ladder up from Level Five. Level Four: Female/Male Barracks (cubicles, nothing), Barracks SanFac, Docking Bay #3 with a lilac nanofilm spool (taken). Auto-doors are now opening "sluggishly" and zooming shut early - sabotage creeping in, nicely unsettling. Ate the gray goo when hungry (can't eat early; the game tells you how many moves). Level Three: Gym (exercise machine; sign warns its diagnostics use frequency 710 - don't bring anything broadcasting on 710 near it), Theatre (projection booth with a lock), Laundry (washer missing! presser and dryer, both empty), Chapel (eternal flame, blinking seven-pointed star out of reach, puce nanofilm spool; pulpit opens to reveal a switch - turning it off put out the flame. No idea why yet). Hands got full; moved bedistor and fromitz board into the survival kit via "Put it in...".

**Cmds 161-215.** Level Two: Mess Hall (cold coffee, food units), Main Storage with a detonator - opened it: a BLACKENED hyperdiode inside (need a good one; I think the detonator is for the safe). Meeting Rooms 1-2; P.A. says a deep-space message arrived at the Comm Center. Library: nanofilm reader. Lilac spool = spacetruck fuel-cell replacement (quarnum wrench) then "You will die, human!". Puce spool = chapel maintenance: flame fuel reservoir, and the Chapel STAR has a hyperdiode! So the star is my diode source; it's out of reach. Dome (top): locked storage bin "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" (fuel cells per the Commander), air shaft grating, paths loop. Elevator keypad takes the level number - nice. Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks + SanFac, Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac (nothing in desks), End of Corridor with another ID-reader security door, dark Shipping Room, Docking Bay #4 (empty), Docking Bay #1 with the ALIEN SHIP: empty pedestal, skeleton, dot pattern: ".. .. / .. .... . ... . ... ... . ... / .. ... . / .... . ... . / .. ... ." Diary said the mayor has linguistic training - so the village mayor can translate?

**Cmds 216-245.** Level Seven: Printing Plant - mauve spool, trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form. Stamped it with the validation stamp (the "Validate..." entry on the stamp was right there). Ladder to Level Eight sealed from below; elevator won't go to 8. Ominous throbbing/clanging from below. Paper Recycling Plant: a drill with a small bit. Hull Welder #1 came at me in the Printing Plant - I saved and escaped into the elevator. Mauve spool = collater repair ("check the lower fromitz... replace with") then "You will die, human!". Pressed the crumpled form in the Laundry presser (put in, close, on, off, open) -> neatly ironed, validated village entry form. Tried drilling the Theatre booth lock with the small and medium bits: "point of the drill doesn't seem to be as hard as the lock" - so I need the Large Drill Bit from the PX (1 galakmid). Footnotes are clickable - fun. Next: village via South Connection slot.

**Cmds 246-285.** Welder #1 again at South Connection - saved, fed the ironed form into the slot: hatch jams half-open, +6 (score 17). Through a Grimy Passage (weightless) into the space village: Main Street (deserted), Travel Agency, Bank (platinum detector - turned it on, no beeps yet), Greasy Straw diner, Trading Post (twelve-prong fromitz board; sign: FREZONE explosive; instruction sheet: explosive in a hole of the right diameter, detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep below 150 K). So the safe plan: drill hole (large bit), Frezone, detonator (needs working hyperdiode - chapel star), timer (PX). Thermos keeps things cold? Grocery: bag of vacuum taffy (left it). Broadway: Recruitment Office, Rec Shop (sim booths), Field Office with a HEADLAMP - finally a light! Wearing it. Ate blue soup when hungry.

**Cmds 286-298.** Broadway W -> Makeshift Connector -> comes out at East Connection (the military hatch is frozen open; it's a village shortcut). Comm Center screen: the Duffy says abort the assignment and come home - the forms were found in a mislabelled pallet. Ha. Turned the headlamp on. File Room: boring files. Storage (north of Workshop): a JAMMER with twenty sockets, settable 0-1400. Put the twenty-prong fromitz board in it and set it to 710 - the gym sign's frequency. Plan: take it to the Gym and see what the exercise machine does.

**Cmds 299-342.** Gym with jammer on at 710, got in the exercise machine, waited: nothing at all happened. Unsure if I solved or wasted it; turned it off. Right after, "the detector is getting warm" - I panicked (log reader memories) and dropped it, then took it back. Chapel: climbing the pulpit - it sways and I fall; Floyd is too short and Plato "several meters" too short to reach the star. Back to the village via the Makeshift Connector. Barbershop: detector "quietly beeping" (mirror is fixed to the wall). Saloon (partially disguised exit east) -> Casino (dice, roulette wheel) where it got "very warm". Dropped it again, it didn't explode, so I took it back and switched it off. I can't tell if warm means danger or hot/cold. Hungry ~53, tired ~96.

**Cmds 343-371.** Trading Post W: "Junk Yard"... no, the Studio (art joke) with a J-series HYPERDIODE in the scrap sculpture - took it, swapped it into the detonator for the blackened one. Headlamp dimming, so it's off when not needed. Pet Store (NW of Trading Post): Arcturian balloon creature in a cage (+ leash); Welder #4 came for me, I opened the cage and fled NE, came back; grabbing the leash made it fart in my face and I dropped everything (Take all fixed it). Need a way to hold it (a nose plug?). I think the balloon floats me/it up to the chapel star (but it can't float in zero-gee - the chapel HAS gravity, so maybe that's the point). Shady Dan's (SE of Trading Post): the "innocuous machine" - ID card in, typed 10 -> Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral! That should open the security doors (Sick Bay E, Level Six End of Corridor N). Below Dan's: the Junk Yard (mirror joke of the Studio) with magnetic boots - wearing them. Dropped the platinum detector in the Junk Yard.

**Cmds 372-375.** Junk Yard W -> Alley (winding hub; exits N, S, NE, SE, SW, W, and up/NW back to Main Street). N: Missionary (end-of-the-world kook's home, nothing visible). Back in the Alley. The leg ended here, at about 375 of 400 commands: the session's tool permissions blocked further harness calls. I did not stop by choice.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far

**Cmds 1-14.** Arrived at Grimy Passage, score 11, tired in ~35 moves (worrying). South to Main Street, W Travel Agency (posters), SE Bank: picked up a platinum detector, switched it on. A hull welder came at me in the Bank; I left north and it wandered off. I think the Thermos in my kit is for carrying it cold. Sign says explosive available. Menus are quick; I like that examining is free.


**Cmds 15-32.** Grocery: plastic bag with vacuum taffy. Broadway is a hub with nine exits. Recruitment Office (dead end), Field Office (headlamp; wearing it, since my hands got full). Rec Shop has simulation booths. Barbershop: the platinum detector beeps here. The mirror is fixed to the wall; I suspect platinum behind it. Worry: tired in ~13 moves and no bed seen yet. Examine costs a turn here, which I did not expect.

**Cmds 33-62.** Pet Store: Arcturian balloon creature (hydrogen-filled) in a cage with a leash; grabbing the leash made it fart and I dropped everything. Funny. Saloon, Casino (dice, roulette wheel). Studio (was 'Junk Yard' until the gag; took J-series hyperdiode). Shady Dan's: a jerry-built machine with keypad and slot, window on a spaceship lot. Down: Junk Yard with magnetic boots, but hands full. A second welder chased me; fled up. Detector got 'warm' so I switched it off and dropped it at Shady Dan's. Sleep button finally appeared, but 'members of civilized societies sleep in beds'. Need a bed, fast.

**Cmds 63-80.** Wore the magnetic boots. Alley hub: Missionary (dead end), Warehouse (airlock door down, red sign; welder #2 again), Loan Shark (strong box fastened to floor: drill/explosive target?), Doc Schuster's (an ostrich floating! letter: 'ostrich nip in my ceiling panel'), Pawn Shop (spray can with lettering). Nice puzzle feel. Still no bed; about to collapse.

**Cmds 81-104.** Collapsed from tiredness in the Mayor's Office; woke fine on day 2 with +3 (score 14). Dropped the textbook and letter. Took the spray can from the Pawn Shop: 'E-Z Spray Sporz, lowest gas-inducement'. Theory: feed the balloon creature so it stops farting and I can hold its leash. Sprayed in the Pet Store; it darted about eating, but it still farted when I grabbed the leash. Theory not confirmed; maybe it needs gravity, or more time.

**Cmds 105-132.** Fortune Teller under Broadway (crystal ball, joke). Broadway NW is a joke non-exit. Barbershop: drill won't dent the mirror, but *break mirror* reveals reflective foil (platinum?), +4, score 18. Ate orange goo (hunger reset ~100). Warehouse red sign: 'Trading Post vacuum storage'. Airlock below: outer door opens only with inner closed; I tested and died of vacuum, then undid. So I need a spacesuit for the storage (probably where the FREZONE is).

**Cmds 133-150.** Shady Dan's 'innocuous machine' is a card alterer (keypad 0-9999, small slot). My ID card is scrambled: the footnote says GOTCHA AGAIN, the magnet. I think the magnetic boots did it. My saves are all after the boots, so no clean way back. Annoying. Left the card there. Pet Store: examining the ceiling revealed the panel from the letter; took the ostrich nip, +3, score 21. Next: feed the nip to the ostrich at Doc's.

**Cmds 151-172.** At Doc's the ostrich sniffs toward the nip. By mis-click I tried to 'get in' the ostrich; it squawked and stuck its head in the disposal hole. Gave it the nip: it got drunk and keeled over, no points. I suspect that was the wrong use, so I restored the Pet Store save (nip in hand). Theory: the nip lures the ostrich, and scaring it makes it put its head in a hole. Need a hole where that matters. Rec Shop simulation booth: a Zork joke. PA: 'Deep-space communication received at Comm Center'.

**Cmds 173-186.** Alley W is another joke non-exit. Loan Shark: drilled a toothpick-size hole in the strong box (HUGE lock). Opened the detonator: a blackened (burnt) hyperdiode. Swapped in the J-series hyperdiode from the sculpture and closed it. A good engineer's puzzle, though no points yet. Still need: FREZONE (vacuum storage, needs a spacesuit) and a timer (maybe my chronometer?). Also need a use for the nip/ostrich. Plan: head back to the station to look for a spacesuit.

**Cmds 187-198.** Blueprint key in Papers: a nice drawing, legible. North into the station: gravity returns at South Connection. A QX-17-T form and a validation stamp lie there. Briefing Room is empty; auto-doors are 'sluggish, zoom shut early' (ominous). Robot Shop: dormant robot Oliver, and a medium drill bit in a heating chamber too small for my hand. Tell Floyd to... take it: +3, score 24 (the menu offered it outright). Swapped the medium bit into the drill and dropped the small bit. Plan: medium hole in the strong box for FREZONE.

**Cmds 199-214.** Station tour. Station Control monitor: Communication, Food, Printing RED; Life Support, Gravity, Power YELLOW. East Connection, then Comm Center: the screen tells me to abort and return to the Duffy (a nice joke). Emergency beacon button not pressed. Sick Bay has a bed and a security door with an ID reader (my card is scrambled...). North Connection has a Scientific Sub-Module tube going north. Storage (dark, headlamp on): a jammer, freq 0-1400, set to 337, twenty tiny sockets. Workshop: took a twenty-ohm bedistor, dropped the taffy bag there. Still no spacesuit.

**Cmds 215-232.** Scientific Sub-Module (north of North Connection). Engineering Office: Prof. Schmidt's diary about the billion-year-old alien pyramid. The alien 'dots' have nonvisual properties (taste!), and the mayor has linguistic training (hence the textbook). Astro Lab: swapped my twelve-prong fromitz board for a twenty-prong one (the jammer has 20 sockets). Scientists' Quarters: beds (good for tonight). Desks and wardrobe are empty.

**Cmds 233-248.** Bio Office note: 'think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph...' with bloodstains. Chilling, and short. Holding tank blasted open and empty (the pyramid escaped). PX: a Vendo-Matic, all items 1 galakmid; only 6 All-Purpose Timer and 9 Large Drill Bit are in stock. That's my timer! I have no coin. Kicking the machine does nothing. Circular worry: the coin may be in the strong box that needs the timer.

**Cmds 249-273.** East Junction joins the loop; File Room is a 'boring' joke. Commander's Quarters: a HyperSecurity safe (8000-setting dial, 12-20 numbers, so drill-and-blast) and a log tape. Drilling the safe: 'the drill sparks and stops running'. The drill is now dead. The log (in the Commander's Office reader, one red button per entry) explains: fuel cells locked in the Dome storage bin, key in the safe; Shady Dan sells modified ID cards; stamp hidden under the Commander's bed; pyramid moved to the holding tank; unexplained breakdowns of simple equipment (sabotage). So my drill was sabotaged too. The logs are good storytelling and each is short. A welder chased me out; the headlamp is dimming (turned off).

**Cmds 274-318.** Ate the gray goo (no food left now!). Put the twenty-prong board in the jammer and switched it on (freq 337, no feedback). Restored the PX save to get a working drill back, re-did the jammer and carried it (on) to the Commander's Quarters. Drill safe again: same 'sparks and stops' at the same time, so it's not sabotage timing. Undid. Drilling the desk works ('not as hard as the desk'). So the safe kills the drill; I probably need a different bit (large bit from the PX, needs a galakmid coin) or a different approach. Headlamp battery dimming.

**Cmds 319-343.** Replayed the full log. New entries: web-feeder shutdown, the spare log reader overheating, and the last entry where a hull welder injured an ensign ('What the krip!...'). Welders are the malfunctioning killers. A few turns later the log reader EXPLODED in the Commander's Office (a black scar). Process note: I once piped harness output through sed while replaying log entries. I read the log text, but the trailing room panels were cut; I stopped doing it. Ate again (gray goo was back after the restore). Spacetruck: no suit. Level Four barracks: nothing but beds. Docking Bay #3: lilac nanofilm spool 'Spacetruck Refueling Instructions' (left there).

**Cmds 344-376.** Level Three: Gym sign says the exercise machine's diagnostics use frequency 710; don't broadcast there. I set the jammer to 710 in the Gym: nothing visible. Theatre: projection booth with a lock the drill can't beat. Chapel: a blinking seven-pointed star 'beyond your reach', an eternal flame, and a puce nanofilm spool (Chapel Maintenance Procedures). The pulpit opens to a switch; I turned the flame OFF. Theory: float up to the star on the hydrogen balloon creature, and the flame must be out first. I dropped everything in the Chapel and trekked to the Pet Store with the spray can. Sprayed spores, took the leash: it still farts and I let go. Waiting and pushing don't help. Leg budget nearly spent; stopping here.

Went west: "Junk Yard" that turns out to be an artist's Studio; took a J-series hyperdiode from the sculpture. Ate the orange goo when hungry (apricot yogurt). Walking back east, an out-of-game notice: the explosive is gone for good, game unwinnable. Opening the Thermos: "sublimes into a puff of FREZONE gas". Undo is only one step. I never saved (the checkpoint didn't give me one), and pressing Save just saved the dead state. Only option: restart from the very beginning. Ugh. In hindsight the Thermos should have gone out into space and had the explosive put in it there, while still cold. (That's my reasoning, not memory - I don't actually remember this puzzle.)

**Cmds 49-84 (restart from the beginning).** New game on the Duffy, Deck Twelve. The forms are shown as real scanned papers - lovely. Robot Pool: form in slot, keypad 3 -> Floyd jumps up and hugs me (the room list had already called him "Floyd" before the reveal, a mild spoiler). SAVED this time. Spacetruck: took the survival kit, form in slot got spat out until both seats were filled; Floyd said "you first", so I sat and he followed. Keyed course 193 from the astrogator table on the assignment form (time 5656). Then I died: I'd left the hatch open and the air went out in space. Fair! Undo, stood up, closed hatch, sat back; launched just in time. Four waits, docked at bay two (+5). Ate the gray goo (tree-mold custard). Tired in ~54 moves, so I need a bed soon.

**Cmds 85-112.** Station is deserted ("Stationfall", nobody to meet us). Level Five lobby: Workshop north had a twenty-ohm bedistor (took it); Storage beyond is pitch dark, no lamp yet. Sick Bay has beds and a security door with an ID reader that ignores my card. Comm Center: the emergency beacon button gives an electric shock - something doesn't want us calling for help. Station Control: a hull welder "quivering with excitement" came at me; I fled and it wandered off. Commander's Office has a log reader bolted down, no tape. Briefing Room, South Connection (iris hatch + slot), Robot Shop with sleeping baby robot Oliver and a heating chamber with a drill bit; told Floyd to fetch it, he dropped it, it cooled, I took it (+3, score 8). Floyd's speech about Oliver was genuinely touching.

**Cmds 113-168.** Commander's Quarters: safe with an 8000-setting dial (12-20 numbers!), and a log tape. Played it in the Commander's Office reader, pressing the red "More" button 8 times: fuel cells locked in the Dome storage bin, key in the safe; alien craft with a featureless pyramid, moved to the Sci Sub-Module holding tank; Shady Dan selling fake IDs; village off-limits; stamp hidden under the bed; machines "malfunctioning", welders attacking people. Great creepy storytelling. Met Plato (poetry-reading robot), who joins Floyd. Found the validation stamp under the Commander's bed; validated my Assignment Completion form ("Done.", no points) and heard an explosion - the log reader blew up, leaving a black scar. Monitor board: COMMUNICATION red, FOOD PRODUCTION red, PRINTING yellow. Level Four: barracks, Docking Bay #3 (lilac nanofilm spool). Level Three: Gym with an ominous exercise machine. Slept in the Female Barracks (+3, score 11); woke Day 2 with all my stuff dropped on the floor.

**Cmds 169-203.** Auto-doors now open sluggishly and slam early - the station is getting worse. Level Three: Theatre (locked projection booth), Laundry (washer missing, presser, empty dryer), Chapel (blinking star out of reach, puce nanofilm spool, a switch in the pulpit that turns the eternal flame off and on). Level Two Mess Hall: the food dispenser sprays ACID instead of breakfast. Ate my last food (orange goo) - ~100 moves to find more. Main Storage: a DETONATOR (now I have drill bit + detonator; I know where an explosive is, from the first run). Library: nanofilm reader; spools are chapel maintenance (mentions a "...iode in the Chapel's star") and spacetruck fuel cell replacement with a "quarnum wrench", both dissolving into static and "You will die, human!" Welder #2 came at me again; fled. Dome on top: locked storage bin (the Commander's fuel cells; key in the safe). 203 commands used.

**Cmds 204-257.** Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks, Docking Bay #1 with the ALIEN SHIP (skeleton, empty pedestal, dot pattern on the wall: `.. .. / .. .... . ... . ... ... . ... / .. ... . / .... . ... . / .. ... .` - maybe a code?), Docking Bay #4 (empty), Officers' Quarters A/B/C, End of Corridor (another ID-reader security door), Shipping Room (dark). PA: "Deep-space communication received at Comm Center" - haven't gone to read it. Down to the Printing Plant: trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form; validated it with the stamp (the floor throbbed, dread). Paper Recycling: took a drill (small bit). Ladder to Level Eight sealed from below. The South Connection slot rejected the crumpled form, so I ironed it in the Laundry presser: neatly ironed form. Very satisfying.

**Cmds 258-316.** Ironed form in the South Connection slot: the hatch half-opens, sparking (+6, score 17). No gravity in the village. Main Street, Bank (platinum detector, left it), Travel Agency (Welder #3!), Alley, Warehouse, Trading Post (sign: "FREZONE explosive available"), Grocery (bag of vacuum taffy = food, I hope), Broadway, Recruitment Office, Rec Shop, Field Office (HEADLAMP, now worn), Barbershop, Fortune Teller (crystal ball), Pet Store (Arcturian balloon creature + leash in a cage; Welder #2 again), Shady Dan's: an "innocuous machine" re-ranks your ID card; I made myself rank 10, Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral (for those ID-reader security doors, I assume). Junk Yard below: MAGNETIC BOOTS (now worn), Welder #4 chased me off. Loan Shark: strong box with a HUGE lock. Drilled it (small bit = toothpick hole), swapped in the medium bit: now a pencil-sized hole. That is exactly the explosive's size - the instruction sheet said "insert in hole of appropriate diameter". Still need: space suit (for the vac yard), the explosive (vac yard below the Warehouse), a timer.

**Cmds 317-396.** Pawn Shop (spray can of "SPORZ" spores), Doc Schuster's (ostrich + letter about "ostrich nip" in a ceiling panel), Missionary, Alley "west" is a joke non-exit. Ate the taffy. Mayor's Office (up from Main Street): "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a paper of taste-words ("bttr/salty/bttr = softness/weakness", etc.). Greasy Straw, Saloon, Casino (dice, roulette). No space suit anywhere yet. Broadway west = Makeshift Connector = back door into the station's East Connection. Comm Center message: my mission is CANCELLED, go home, ha. Then the Sick Bay reader said my HyperAdmiral card was "magnetically damaged"; Shady Dan's machine said "scrambled", and footnote 15 said "GOTCHA AGAIN!" - the magnetic boots I wore with the card in my pocket wiped it. I restored to my Shady Dan's save (lost the strong-box drilling and the boots), re-ranked to 10, and went in WITHOUT boots: the Sick Bay security door opens (just an empty Brig). North Connection -> Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module: Engineering Lab, Engineering Office (Prof. Schmidt's diary: the alien dots have "nonvisual properties" - TASTE? - and "the mayor" can read them; pyramid over a billion years old), Astro Lab (twenty-prong fromitz board), Astro Office. Saved there. Stopped at 396/400.

## Leg handoff

**State:** score 17 (best this leg 54, but that was the unwinnable checkpoint game I had to abandon), Day 2 (Novem 5), time ~4426, in the **Astro Office** (Sci Sub-Module), saved there. Carrying: twenty-prong fromitz board, drill (small bit), medium drill bit, detonator, validation stamp, twenty-ohm bedistor, survival kit (Thermos, empty), headlamp (worn), uniform with ID card (**rank 10, working - keep it away from the magnetic boots**). Hungry in ~97, tired in ~141. Save slots: Astro Office (latest), Sick Bay, Loan Shark, Shady Dan's.

**Warning, lost in this restore:** the pencil hole I drilled in the Loan Shark's strong box and the magnetic boots are undone. The boots are back in the Junk Yard under Shady Dan's (Welder #4 hangs around there).

### Map so far
- Duffy: Deck Twelve, Forms Storage, Cargo Bay Entrance, Robot Pool, Cargo Bay/Spacetruck. Course from the astrogator table on form QX-17-T by time of day; **close the hatch before launch**.
- Station L5: Level Five hub; W Docking Bay #2 (truck); N Workshop -> Storage (dark); NE North Junction -> N North Connection (W Storage, E ?) -> N Tube -> Sci Sub-Module (Eng Lab/Office, Astro Lab/Office, up/down gangways unexplored); E Sick Bay -> E Brig (ID door); SE East Connection (E = grimy connector to Broadway), S Comm Center, SW Station Control; South Junction -> SE Commander's Office -> E Commander's Quarters (safe, 8000-dial), S Briefing Room, S South Connection (S to village Grimy Passage), W Robot Shop (Oliver, heating chamber). South Junction SW unexplored.
- L4: barracks, SanFac, Docking Bay #3. L3: Gym, Theatre (locked booth), Laundry (presser), Chapel (star, pulpit switch). L2: Mess Hall (acid FDU), Main Storage, Meeting Rooms 1-2, Library (nanofilm reader). Top: Dome (locked warm storage bin, air shaft grating).
- L6: Aux Barracks/SanFac, Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: pedestal, dots, skeleton), Docking Bay #4, Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac, End of Corridor (ID-door north; E Shipping Room dark). L7: Printing Plant, Paper Recycling. L8 sealed from below.
- Village (no gravity): Grimy Passage, Main Street (Up Mayor's Office), Bank, Travel Agency, Alley (Loan Shark, Pawn Shop, Doc's, Missionary, Junk Yard, Warehouse), Warehouse (airlock down to the vac yard; explosive out there), Trading Post, Grocery, Broadway (Recruitment, Rec Shop, Field Office, Barbershop, Fortune Teller, Pet Store, Makeshift Connector W), Shady Dan's, Studio (W of Trading Post), Saloon, Casino, Greasy Straw.

### Puzzles solved
Robot Pool (form + 3), spacetruck (both seats, course by time, close hatch), drill bit (Floyd fetches from heating chamber), log tape (stamp under the Commander's bed), village entry (crumpled form from Printing Plant trash -> validate -> iron in Laundry presser -> South Connection slot, +6), ID rank 10 at Shady Dan's, Sick Bay/Brig security door.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Commander's safe** (key to the Dome bin with fuel cells): drill a pencil hole with the medium bit, insert the FREZONE explosive, attach the detonator to the explosive and a timer, set the timer, leave. The Loan Shark strong box takes the same treatment.
- **The explosive** is in the vac yard below the Warehouse. It sublimes if it stays above 150 K for ~100 millichrons. My theory: take the open Thermos OUT into space, put the explosive in there, close it, and hurry. Don't carry it bare indoors. Needs a space suit (not found yet: try the Theatre booth, Shipping Room with the lamp, Storage, Sci Sub-Module up/down, South Junction SW) plus magnetic boots (Junk Yard). **Don't carry the ID card while wearing the boots.**
- Timer: not found yet.
- Alien dots: Schmidt says they have nonvisual properties and the Mayor's taste-dictionary translates them. Maybe lick/taste the dots?
- Chapel star has a hyperdiode (per the nanofilm); a J-series hyperdiode is in the Studio sculpture.
- The Comm Center beacon button gives an electric shock.
- Welders (#2, #3, #4) hunt you; leaving the room always shakes them so far.

### What I would try next
Explore the Sci Sub-Module up/down gangways (the pyramid holding tank should be here), then North Connection east, South Junction SW, the Theatre booth and the dark rooms (the headlamp works), all looking for a space suit and a timer. Then boots + suit, vac yard with the Thermos, explosive into the Commander's safe.

friction.result: The food in the survival kit instantly crystallizes and drifts away.
friction.why: Lost all my food with zero warning while 21 moves from hungry; only undo saved me. A first-timer without undo would be stuck.

friction.command: 509 eat (orange goo, in kit on floor)
friction.result: You're not holding the survival kit.
friction.why: The menu offered Eat but it cost a turn and failed; Read on the explosive auto-took it, so this felt inconsistent while I was about to starve.

friction.result: 'Junk Yard' description, then immediately '## Studio' with a second full description
friction.why: Two room names and two descriptions for one step; I wasn't sure if I had moved twice. Funny joke, but the double block reads like a glitch.

friction.result: "953" is not an entry of Papers (while listing 953 Blueprint key)
friction.why: The instructions say '<number> <entry>' works, but it rejected an entry it had just listed; plain '953' worked.

friction.result: (The explosive is gone for good... the game can no longer be won. RESTORE or start again.)
friction.why: The explosive vanished from the closed Thermos with no in-story message; I only learned via the out-of-game notice. Glad the notice exists (saves hours), but I never saw it melt away - I had put it in the Thermos precisely to save it.

friction.command: 5 (Save), looking for a way to Restore
friction.result: Restore button only appears after a save; I had none, so my only save is of the unwinnable state
friction.why: The dead-end notice says RESTORE a saved position, but nothing ever prompted me to save and undo is one step deep. Only choice left is restart from the very beginning, losing 51 points of progress.

friction.result: Text: robot in third bin crouched, can't see him well. Room list: '516 Floyd...'
friction.why: The clickable list names the hidden robot before the story reveals him, spoiling a reveal the prose is clearly setting up.

friction.result: The truck roars out... air gushes out through the open hatch. You have died
friction.why: Totally fair, funny death, and the death screen offering Undo made it painless. Learned to close hatches.

friction.command: 516 Tell Floyd to... -> 667 Take the medium drill bit
friction.result: Floyd grabs the hot bit, drops it, it cools
friction.why: The contextual 'Tell Floyd to' list surfaced exactly the idea I needed after the hand-too-big message. Satisfying, though it half-solves the puzzle for you.

friction.result: Commander's log: fuel cells locked in Dome bin with key in safe, stamp under bed, alien pyramid, machines malfunctioning
friction.why: Best moment so far: creepy story delivered in chunks, and it hands me concrete leads (stamp under the bed, key in safe).

friction.command: 8 Take all (while still in bed after waking)
friction.result: 'You can't reach X from the bed' for every item, including Floyd and Plato
friction.why: The Take all button is offered while it can't work from the bed, and it tries to pick up the robots. Also waking up with all my stuff dumped on the floor was a surprise. Cost a turn with 17 moves to hunger.

friction.command: 778 Put it in presser, close, turn on, open
friction.result: neatly ironed Illegal Space Village Entry Form
friction.why: Crumpled form won't fit the slot -> iron it in the laundry presser. Clever, fair, and the laundry I'd seen earlier paid off. Felt smart.

friction.result: At the moment, the screen is displaying a message.
friction.why: Examine told me there's a message but not what it says; I had to open the menu again and pick Read. Small, but it cost a turn and nearly made me leave.

friction.command: 649 put ID card in Sick Bay reader (after re-ranking it to 10 at Shady Dan's)
friction.result: Magnetically-stored data has been damaged; see the Security Officer
friction.why: My freshly-hacked Admiral card is wiped and nothing told me when or why. My guess is the magnetic boots I put on while the card was in my uniform pocket, but that's only a guess. It feels like a silent trap.

Generated by `node scripts/playtest-registry.mjs report 4` from playtests/REGISTRY.jsonl and the round's friction JSONL. Do not edit by hand; re-run it.

96 friction rows this round (32 of them praise, counted and not triaged); 64 linked to 43 issues (26 new, 17 repeats); 0 not yet linked.

By tier: 8 A, 4 B, 31 C.

Suggested A/B/C is the registry's guess from the kind (A: build it, B: a deviation for the sponsor, C: leave it as the original). **Norm confirms each one** (`confirm <id> A|B|C`) after checking it against the ZIL and the oracle.

## New issues

| Issue | Title | Area / room | Kind | Rows this round | Rows in all | Rounds | Suggested | Norm confirms | Status | Evidence |

| SF-084 | No warning reaches the player while the explosive melts inside the closed Thermos, and nothing says how long the Thermos keeps it | Village / East Connection | confusing | 0 | 0 | 4 | B | B | open | The original. I-EXPLOSIVE-MELT adds C-ELAPSED/4 per turn in the closed Thermos and C-ELAPSED otherwise (interrupts.zil 358-365), so the melt runs on the clock, not on turns: a walk is 22 millichrons lit, 33 dark (V-WALK, verbs.zil 2345-2348), so 5 per walk sealed; EXAMINE is 32 (verbs.zil 803), so 8; the default move is 7 (misc.zil 381), so 1. Past 210 it is gone (366-373), about 38 lit walks after sealing; the warnings print only while it is visible and lit (374-383). Proposal (Q7), behind the D12 switch: when the counter passes 130 and 170 with the explosive in the closed Thermos, one bracketed line says the explosive is softening even sealed. |
| SF-085 | The can't-be-won notice (SF-077) interrupts Plato's speech, and says RESTORE when there is no saved position | Page / East Connection | blocked | 1 | 1 | 4 | A | A | open | Our own deviation (Q6 default, 58746c3): hooks.turnEnd (rules/library.js) prints the line at the end of the turn the explosive goes, which in r4-typed-05day2 (command 352) was the turn Plato's ambush began, so it landed under the stun text; and it says RESTORE whatever the save slot holds (r4-click-06plato had none, and its one UNDO cannot help: the undone turn is still past 205 and the next walk melts it). Fix: hold the line while STUNNED or while I-PLATO-ATTACK is queued, and print it at the first turn end after; word it from what exists: 'RESTORE your saved position' when a save exists, else 'start again (Restart, or this checkpoint again)'. No auto-save at a checkpoint start: it would only restore the same start. |
| SF-086 | Floyd is named in the Robot Pool list before the text reveals him | Click menus / Robot Pool | other | 1 | 1 | 4 | C | A | open | Interface. The text calls him the robot in the third bin until his TOUCHBIT is set (DESCRIBE-FLOYD, ship.zil 664-668); the object's DESC is "Floyd" (ship.zil 279-281). Oracle (seed 1: EAST, NORTH, LOOK): the reveal comes on the next turn. Fix: the room list labels FLOYD "robot in the third bin" until FLOYD has TOUCHBIT. No game text changes. |
| SF-087 | Tell Floyd to… offers "Take the medium drill bit" only for what is in the heating chamber, which gives the puzzle away | Click menus / Robot Shop | other | 1 | 1 | 4 | C | A | open | Interface, D15 (no entry marks a puzzle). rules/robots.js:854 (shared) adds "Take the X" for HEATING-CHAMBER's contents alone. FLOYD-F answers TAKE of anything (the chamber's bit, or a whine; SF-010). Fix: one "Take…" submenu under Tell Floyd to…, listing every takeable thing drawn here, the chamber's contents among them. |
| SF-088 | The compass calls joke non-exits and a real Out alike "special", and keeps offering a joke exit already tried | Click menus / Alley | tedious | 2 | 2 | 4 | B | A | open | Interface. engine/zmenus.js:181-182 titles every string exit (world.json kind 'blocked') 'special' (SF-047), and ui/ui.js:306 falls back to 'special' for any exit it cannot name, so the Spacetruck's Out to Docking Bay #2 reads the same as Alley W ("there are openings in ALMOST every direction"). Fix: name the target room when the exit leads somewhere; once a string exit has answered, title it 'tried' and dim it. The refusals are the original's. |
| SF-089 | Diagnose's "tired in ~N moves" reads as a deadline, and there is no Sleep until tired and in a bed | Survival / Pet Store | blocked | 2 | 2 | 4 | A | A | open | Our own D12 text (engine/zmenus.js:540). V-SLEEP refuses until SLEEPY-LEVEL is set and then wants a bed (verbs.zil 1758-1765); left awake, you drop off where you stand and wake on day 2 (I-SLEEP-WARNINGS, globals.zil 906-938), which is no death. The Sleep button appears once tired (SF-007, SF-037), as r4-click-03village#2 found. Fix: the note reads "sleepy in ~N moves", so it is not read as a collapse countdown. |

I-LOG-READER whines at its 12th and 13th turns only while HERE is the office, and at the 14th explodes: death in the office, "You hear an explosion from nearby" in four rooms next door (interrupts.zil 435-456). Both testers left and walked back in on the 14th; the replay of r4-typed-05day2 on our engine matches the transcript (command 194; only the death screen's clock differs, 4502 against the live 4504, a harness save/load matter). The log text warns (station.zil 834, 854). Proposal (Q7), behind the D12 switch: the two whine turns are also heard in those four rooms, as "You hear a whine from nearby." Related: SF-033. |

## Repeats (already in the registry: counted, not re-triaged)
